visual_identity.color_palette: Dusty ochre and terracotta plumage with deep navy-blue accents on the wing-feathers; pale cream underbelly.
visual_identity.texture: Dense downy feathering with large, stiff pennaceous feathers on the forearms and tail; smooth, keratinous beak.
visual_identity.distinguishing_marks: Vibrant blue skin around the eyes; large, sharp black talons on the hands.

anatomy_constraints.head: Deep, toothless, parrot-like beak; small crest on the top of the skull; large, expressive yellow eyes.
anatomy_constraints.limbs: Exceptionally long, slender legs for high-speed running; three-fingered hands with large claws.
anatomy_constraints.body: Giant bird-like frame; short tail tipped with a fan of display feathers.

visual_logic.subject: A majestic, curious Gigantoraptor inspecting its surroundings.
visual_logic.action: Standing among the yellowish-orange sands and mottled red clays of a braided river system.
visual_logic.environment: Background features early walnut-like trees and mistletoe-like shrubs under a bright, high-key sun.

personality: The 'Vibrant Watcher'—intelligent, visually striking, and surprisingly graceful for its size.
